merge.signature: f(out: *mut [u8; 24], frame: *const Frame56, direction: u64, edge_idx: u64)
merge.direction: 1 = current is RIGHT node (left-sibling donor path); 0 = current is LEFT node (right-sibling donor path); direction selects only the edge bound and the output edge remap, never the survivor
merge.survivor: LEFT node always kept; RIGHT node always freed
out_layout_24: [0x10] edge index in merged node = edge_idx + (direction ? left_count + 1 : 0)
merge.separator_move: parent key/value at separator index saved, then parent keys/values after it shift left by one; separator appended to left node at old-count slot; right keys/values appended after it
merge.parent_children: child at index sep+1 removed by left shift (memmove); shifted children reparented single-step (N mod 4) then unrolled-by-4, N = parent_count - sep - 1 (stale tail slot included, dead after count decrement); parent count decremented
merge.kept_children: internal only (frame+0x8 >= 2): right children appended to left children at left_count+1 (memcpy), reparented single-step ((right_count+1) mod 4) then unrolled-by-4 to merged total
